name: WayriCAD Visual Diff
description: Compare PCB and schematic Git revisions with native KiCad SVGs in a local interactive report.
description_full: Minimal local launcher for saved Git revisions. Compare sheets and PCB layers side by side, overlay, swipe, or inspect a raster change map with shared coordinates and pan/zoom. Offline HTML reports bundle all assets. Includes CLI and optional, separately invoked GitHub integration. Requires Git and KiCad 10+ CLI; does not modify boards or include unsaved editor changes. IPC only discovers the current saved board path; future KiCad compatibility is unverified.
